items.title: 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution (air pollution kam karne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.14 with Figure 14.6, printed pages 317-318.

blocks.text: Air pollution kam karne aur air quality behtar karne ke liye kai technologies istemal hoti hain. Pollutants ka emission control karne ke liye yeh paanch types ki technologies istemal ho sakti hain:
